\section[(dialogue)]{Time, places, the town, clothes and numbers — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R99-second-pass-time-places-the-town-clothes-and-numbers}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item yesterday, tomorrow, now, sometimes, before
  \item after, time, far, near, inside
  \item outside, above, below, in front of, behind
  \item here, there, right, a shop, a street
  \item a road, a bank, a station, a car, a bus
  \item a train, a bridge, a mosque, a hotel, an office; a desk
  \item the police, a market, a village, a city, a restaurant
  \item clothes, a shirt, a dress, trousers, a sock
  \item a pocket, a ring, a hat, a shoe, a coat
  \item a belt, six, seven, eight, nine
  \item ten, thirty, forty, fifty, a thousand
  \item a colour, a song, a journey, a holiday, love
  \item music, news, a country, a language, a story
\end{itemize}

Yesterday? (\textbf{\ar{أمس}}, \emph{ams}.) Tomorrow? (\textbf{\ar{غدا}}, \emph{ghadan}.) Now? (\textbf{\ar{الآن}}, \emph{al-ān}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{\ar{أحيانا}}, \emph{aḥyānan}.) Before?
